metadata.description: Personal, hand-vetted collection of Claude skills.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Run quality checks and draft a Conventional Commits message, then commit staged changes.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Initializes .claude/ infrastructure (CLAUDE.md, rules, skills, hooks) for any project. Includes a companion refresh skill for keeping docs in sync as code evolves.

plugins.name: ai-engineering-workspace
plugins.description: Generic AI-engineering ticket suite: workspace scaffolding, phase-gated ticket workflow, structured bug fix, cross-session handoff, and ticket completion knowledge extraction.

plugins.name: system-design-coach
plugins.description: System design learning coach with roadmap planning, interactive case drills, answer review, and a maintenance handoff for future expansion.

plugins.name: weiwei-notes
plugins.description: Turn discussions, debugging sessions, or ticket analysis into notes/blog articles in Weiwei's writing style (结论先行, 根因导向, 中英混合).

plugins.name: xhs-topic-digest
plugins.description: Turns a xiaohongshu (小红书) keyword search into a UGC content digest — consensus, disagreements, recommendations, and warnings drawn from post bodies and comments, not an engagement-metrics analysis.
